topography.project_purpose: Options Vault. Structurally: 149 project-authored contract(s) across 2 chain(s); 29 ERC20 tokens, 1 Chainlink feed; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 6 functional families. Its contracts share 25 common project-authored base contract(s) (dsmath, optionsvaultstorage, optionsvaultstoragev1). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
